subject: notice of bug fix for dCRP users

messages.author: 5fa2a363d4ddd1d1
messages.subject: notice of bug fix for dCRP users
parts:
Dear nimble-users members,

For those of you who are using the dCRP distribution in NIMBLE for
Bayesian non-parametric functionality, we've fixed a bug in version
0.7.0 that we wanted to make potentially-affected users aware of.

The bug was introduced in version 0.7.0 of NIMBLE (our most recent
version, released a few
weeks ago) during our efforts to improve efficiency of MCMC sampling
for BNP models. It causes incorrect MCMC sampling when using the dCRP
distribution in non-conjugate situations (i.e., where the base measure
and the mixture kernel are _not_ conjugate). For those of you who have
been using the dCRP distribution we ask that you update your version
of NIMBLE off our development version and rerun any MCMCs you've run.

To get the fix, please install NIMBLE from Github:

devtools::install_github('nimble-dev/nimble/packages/nimble@hotfix_bnp_update')

For those of you who are Windows users, you may need to do the
installation with administrative privileges. We've also heard a report
from a user that using the argument "force = TRUE" in the call to
install_github may help if you encounter an installation issue.

We'll also be including this fix in version 0.7.1 which should be
released in 2-3 weeks.

- Chris Paciorek for the NIMBLE Development Team
